title: Mushroom Oracle Sphere
description: A glowing crystal ball rests on a dark ornate base filled with colorful pebbles. Inside the sphere, a bright orange brain-like orb connects via luminous blue energy tendrils to glowing mushrooms, fan-shaped flowers, and a human finger touching the sphere from the right, emitting light. A surreal landscape with water and rock formations is visible in the background.
prompt: A surreal glowing crystal ball on an ornate base with colorful pebbles at the bottom. Inside the transparent sphere, a bright orange brain-like orb sits atop a dark stem, emitting blue energy tendrils that connect to large glowing blue mushrooms, vibrant fan-shaped flowers, and a human finger touching the sphere from the right side. A dreamy landscape with water and purple rock formations is visible in the background, all rendered in a vibrant neon fantasy style with magical atmosphere.
